fields.label: Label
fields.description: Text shown in the cash flow report for this line.

fields.label: Calculation Type
fields.options:
GL: credit minus debit
GL: debit minus credit
SLE: inventory change
fields.description: GL: credit minus debit — payables, equity (increase = inflow). GL: debit minus credit — add back non-cash charges like depreciation. SLE: inventory change — (opening − closing) from Stock Ledger; for non-perpetual inventory.

fields.label: Is Working Capital
fields.description: Check for working capital items (receivables, payables, inventory). Grouped under the working capital sub-section in Operating Activities.

fields.label: Is Finance Cost
fields.description: Check if this represents finance costs (e.g. interest expense). Used for adjustments in Operating Activities.

fields.label: Is Income Tax Expense
fields.description: Check if this represents income tax expense. Used for tax adjustment in Operating Activities.

fields.label: Accounts
fields.description: Select the GL accounts that make up this cash flow line. Leave empty when Calculation Type is 'SLE: inventory change'.
